# hysteria2-child (`libnovahysteriachild.so`)

Nova's minimal Hysteria2 Android child: a SOCKS5-only Hysteria2 client run as
a separate OS process by `Hysteria2VpnService` (B46-3C / B46-4A). It is NOT the
stock `hysteria` client and never imports `app/internal/tun` (no `sing-tun`).

## Sources

| File | Origin |
|---|---|
| `src/main.go` | Nova wrapper. Identical to the B46-3C source (`research/b46-3c-hysteria-process-isolated-dataplane/hysteria-child/main.go` @ `7680501`, = B46-2P final) plus the B46-4A changes below |
| `src/socks5_server.go` | Copy of upstream `app/internal/socks5/server.go` @ the pin (MIT, see `UPSTREAM-LICENSE.md`), deviations marked `NOVA B46-4A` |
| `src/socks5_server_test.go` | B46-4A tests |

Upstream: `github.com/apernet/hysteria` @ `e1366b173ccf5706e1e4630fe8aa654a4b574085`.
No upstream file is modified; the wrapper is copied into `app/novaminimal/` of
a checkout of that commit and built there.

## B46-4A local SOCKS5 hardening

- Config file must contain `socksUsername` and `socksPassword` (per-session,
  generated by the app); the child exits if either is missing.
- `socksListen` must be a `127.0.0.1` address (the app passes `127.0.0.1:0`);
  the bound address is reported as `SOCKS5_LISTENING addr=<addr> auth=required`.
  The `auth=required` marker is required by the app - a pre-hardening child
  is refused.
- SOCKS5 authentication is mandatory (`Serve` refuses a nil `AuthFunc`;
  constant-time comparison).
- UDP ASSOCIATE must declare `127.0.0.1:<non-zero>`; `0.0.0.0`, port 0,
  other IPs, domains and IPv6 are refused (`RepNotAllowed`).
- The UDP relay is pinned to the declared client address before any datagram
  is read; the upstream "first UDP sender becomes the client" rule is removed.
- The SOCKS password is redacted from logged errors like the other secrets.

Must ship together with the matching `tun2socks-child` (see that README).

## Build (reproducible)

```bash
bash third_party/hysteria2-child/build-hysteria2-child.sh            # -> android/app/src/main/jniLibs/arm64-v8a/
bash third_party/hysteria2-child/build-hysteria2-child.sh /some/dir  # elsewhere
```

`GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.5`, `CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=android GOARCH=arm64`,
`go build -trimpath -buildvcs=false`. Sources must be LF (`.gitattributes`;
the script refuses CRLF - CRLF changes the ELF).
